newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds see 107-17 as pivotal support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds see 107-17 as pivotal support.

text.p: June T-bond futures will seek support at 107-17 on Thursday if they are to attempt to push higher, but a failure to hold that level could signal a slide towards 107-00, technical analysts said.

"T-bonds look like they are in some sort of fourth wave trading range in Elliott wave terms," said Stavros Loizou, manager of strategic trading group at Fuji Bank in London. "If they go through 107-17 it argues they have completed the up move and are going to correct, possibly down as low as 107-00."
"However as long as they hold 107-17 there is no reason why the shouldn't have an attempt at 109-00," he said.
At 1004 GMT, June T-bond futures were at 107-25 in automated trade, up two basis points from Wednesday's Chicago settlement.
On daily charts 107-17 was the low on April 22. The contract has been trading in a range 107-17 and 108-11 since the end of last week.
Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London, also said T-bonds had to hold above support which he placed in a zone from 107-17 down to 107-12.
"Failure to stay above here would set up 106-12 again," he said in a research note, but added that this was not his favoured view.
"The favoured stance is more neutral to positive for the bond with 109-00 still looking on," Celaya said.
That level was the high on March 24 and would denote a return to a higher trading range.
Loizou said near term resistance levels were at 107-28 and then more importantly at 108-08.
At the short end September Eurodollars were at 93.735, unchanged on the day. So far the contract has traded between 93.730 and 93.740 in automated trade.
